name: A Fireworks Meeting
source:
A short, simple story about two people who although very much in love, only have one last day to spend together.

[From [url=https://ashlex.itch.io/a-fireworks-meeting]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個簡短而樸素的故事，講的是兩個深深愛著彼此的人，卻只剩下最後一天能夠相守。
